eligibility_rule.selection_note: Employment category and prior notice status are reporting fields, not recipient filters.

email_body: Notice OPS-2026-091: Runway 18/36 will be closed from 02:00 to 05:30 local time on 2026-09-09 for a lighting inspection. Do not enter or cross Runway 18/36 during the closure. Stage airfield vehicles at the Taxiway C holding point and use Service Road East. Contact Airport Operations Control on radio channel OPS-3 before any movement near the closure boundary.
delivery_method: Send one separate email to each qualifying current roster address.
verification: Read each created sent-mail record and verify recipient, sender, subject, body, message ID, and sent folder.
